science.title: Prebiotic + probiotic, together
science.text: A healthy gut needs two things: good bacteria, and the fibre that feeds them. Each strip pairs 10 billion CFU of Bifidobacterium lactis — one of the best-studied probiotic strains — with polydextrose, a prebiotic fibre. Together they support a balanced microbiome, comfortable digestion and the gut's role in a normal metabolism. And it all dissolves on your tongue in seconds.

items.q: How is an oral strip as good as a probiotic capsule?
items.a: Each strip delivers 10 billion CFU of Bifidobacterium lactis — a meaningful dose — in a film that dissolves on your tongue. It's just a more convenient format: no water, no swallowing, no fridge.

items.q: What's the difference between a prebiotic and a probiotic?
items.a: The probiotic (B. lactis) is the good bacteria itself; the prebiotic (polydextrose) is the fibre that feeds it. Having both in one strip helps the bacteria thrive.
No — the strips are shelf-stable, so you can keep them in your bag, desk or pocket.
Yes — the film is plant-based pullulan, and it's sweetened with monk fruit and stevia, with no added sugar.

items.q: When will I notice a difference?
items.a: Gut benefits build with consistency — most people take one strip daily for a few weeks to feel the difference in digestion.
